name: Hiradan ~Idol Kaichou Hirasaka Tooru Dungeon ni Hourikomareru~
original_name: ひらだん ～アイドル会長比良坂透 ダンジョンに放り込まれる～
source:
Sometime before summer break, Sueyoshi from the student council asked Tooru
to try and see the legendary "old sakura" together.
Tooru agreed to accompany him, and they made their way to a thicket on their way home.

What they saw there was--- a single old sakura tree that was blossoming mid-summer.

Play as the female student council president and explore the 3D dungeon with an accompanying man in this ecchi ADV

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE247447.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假前的某天，学生会的Sueyoshi邀请透，想一起去看看传说中的“古老樱树”。
透答应陪他同去，两人在放学回家的路上，走进了一片树丛。

他们在那里看见的，竟是一棵在盛夏中盛开的古老樱树。

在这款情色文字冒险游戏中，你将扮演女学生会长，与一名同行男子探索3D迷宫。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE247447.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
